verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a first-party CLI is a single mention of the "WorkOS CLI migrations tool" for exporting Auth0 data, which shows an official CLI exists but only for a narrow migration task. CLI Auth (device authorization flow) is a building block for customers' own CLIs, not a WorkOS CLI, so it earns no credit; the MCP server is a different capability. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose CLI for managing WorkOS resources, an install and command reference, agent/AI-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
